It arrives sealed in clear plastic wrap with a printed card from Stoneworks Lapidary titled Break Your Own Geode, noting that these geodes are found in Morocco and instructing the user to tap moderately with a hammer until they crack open to reveal the crystal structure inside, wrapping the stone in a cloth or wearing safety glasses first. Includes the geode, the wrap and the instruction card. The interior has not been opened, so the crystal formation inside is unknown.

Condition: Unopened and intact. Loose sandy grit and a few small stone crumbs inside the wrap. Small pink paint mark on the surface.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

description:
Natural Mineral Specimen Lot - 2 Pieces
Amethyst and Titanium Aura Quartz
Vintage Collection
This two-piece mineral collection features distinct geological specimens prized for their crystalline structure and color. The lot includes a classic natural amethyst cluster and a treated aura quartz specimen, representing both natural formations and enhanced mineral aesthetics popular in mid-century and modern lapidary collections.
Pieces Included:
Natural Amethyst Cluster - Approximately 3 inches wide, featuring deep purple crystalline points on a natural rocky matrix base.
Titanium Aura Quartz Cluster - Approximately 2.5 inches wide, featuring a metallic iridescent coating with rainbow hues of gold, purple, and blue over a crystal base.
Condition:
Both specimens are in excellent vintage condition. The crystal points are well-defined with no significant post-extraction damage. Natural matrix variations and surface textures are consistent with authentic mineral specimens. No visible repairs or synthetic reconstructions.

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

- Markings: No visible brand or manufacturer markings

shipping.policy:
COMBINED SHIPPING - Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item. We will only combine up to 20lbs. We reserve the right to deny combined shipping when there is a probability for damage.
SHIPPING - All items ship via FedEx from our Indianapolis warehouse unless otherwise indicated in the item listing. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). We are unable to ship to APO or military addresses. Please allow 5 business days ( Monday-Friday) for your purchase to be shipped.
Please note: we no longer offer shipping to Canada.
THANK YOU for shopping with Goodwill of Central and Southern Indiana, we appreciate your business.

description: This listing includes an assorted collection of natural mineral specimens featuring selenite sticks, an amethyst cluster, and quartz geodes. The quartz geodes are large with white to clear crystal interiors. There are three semi-transparent, striated selenite sticks included. A small cluster of purple amethyst crystals is also part of the collection. All minerals are unbranded, raw, unpolished, and natural. Specimens are in used but good condition with minor natural variations and typical wear. Suitable for display, metaphysical use, or educational purposes.

description: This listing includes a trio of natural quartz geodes with rough tan to light brown outer surfaces and crystal formations inside. The largest geode has a rounded shape with cavities lined with small quartz crystals. The two smaller geodes have lighter outer hues and open crystal interiors. Specimens are unpolished, showing typical surface texture and mineral coloration. Light dust is present. See photos for condition.
